mapper.sql: o.order_id,o.order_no,o.service_id,o.service_name,(select s.carousel_images from zjudg_service s where s.service_id=o.service_id) service_image,(select c.category_name from zjudg_service s left join zjudg_service_category c on c.category_id=s.category_id where s.service_id=o.service_id) category_name,(select c.image_url from zjudg_service s left join zjudg_service_category c on c.category_id=s.category_id where s.service_id=o.service_id) category_image,o.city_id,o.user_id,o.user_info,o.master_id,o.dispatch_status,o.dispatch_time,o.accept_time,o.start_time,o.finish_time,o.finish_photos,o.appointment_date,o.slot_id,o.slot_name,o.quantity,o.quantity_unit,o.address,o.phone,o.amount,o.master_price,o.order_status,o.payment_status,o.payment_source,o.settle_status,o.master_income,o.platform_fee,o.settle_time,o.remark,o.create_by,o.create_time,o.update_time,(select count(1) from zjudg_service_review r where r.order_id=o.order_id) reviewed
mapper.select:
select from zjudg_order o
order by o.create_time desc

select ,coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),nullif(o.user_info,''),'-') admin_user_info from zjudg_order o left join sys_user u on u.user_id=o.user_id
order by o.create_time desc

select from zjudg_order o where o.order_id=#{id} and o.master_id=#{masterId}

select from zjudg_order o where o.order_id=#{id} and o.user_id=#{userId} and o.order_status='2'
mapper.update: update zjudg_order set order_status=#{targetStatus},update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where order_id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId} and order_status=#{fromStatus}
mapper.delete: delete from zjudg_order where order_id=#{id} and order_status='3' and payment_status='0' and (master_id is null or master_id='') and not exists (select 1 from zjudg_order_payment p where p.order_id=zjudg_order.order_id) and not exists (select 1 from zjudg_refund r where r.order_id=zjudg_order.order_id) and not exists (select 1 from zjudg_service_review r where r.order_id=zjudg_order.order_id) and not exists (select 1 from zjudg_order_extra_time e where e.order_id=zjudg_order.order_id) and not exists (select 1 from zjudg_dispatch_record d where d.order_id=zjudg_order.order_id)

update zjudg_order set order_status=#{targetStatus},update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where order_id=#{id} and master_id=#{masterId} and order_status=#{fromStatus}
update zjudg_order set order_status=#{targetStatus},start_time=sysdate(),update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where order_id=#{id} and master_id=#{masterId} and order_status=#{fromStatus}

update zjudg_order set order_status=#{targetStatus},finish_time=sysdate(),finish_photos=#{finishPhotos},update_by=#{operator},update_time=sysdate() where order_id=#{id} and master_id=#{masterId} and order_status=#{fromStatus}
mapper.select: select round(avg(r.rating),1) from zjudg_service_review r join zjudg_order o on o.order_id=r.order_id where o.master_id=#{masterId} and o.order_status='2'

and dispatch_status=#{expectDispatchStatus}
